Click a comparative class, canonical use, or provisional use to zoom. Atomic claims are terminal and do not zoom. Hover over any circle to view its title and code. Only claims linked through an eligible provisional-to-canonical mapping are shown. CFC-000 and restricted, excluded, or retired records are omitted. The same claim may appear beneath more than one analytical path. Circle area represents displayed claim paths, not cultural importance, evidentiary strength, frequency, or independent observations.
